title: A/P Unpaid Invoices groups vendors by name, rows oldest date first
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Two vendors have overdue bills on today's date: {Vendor-A} and {Vendor-B}; {Vendor-B}'s name comes first alphabetically.
    For example: {Vendor-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S1-11 Baker and {Vendor-B} is ZZAUTOTEST S1-11 Abbott.
  • {Vendor-B} has three overdue bills: {Bill-A} with the oldest date, and {Bill-B} and {Bill-C} with the same later date. {Bill-B}'s number is smaller than {Bill-C}'s but has fewer digits.
    For example: {Bill-A} is dated 40 days ago; {Bill-B} (S1-99) and {Bill-C} (S1-100) are dated 35 days ago.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Finance > A/P Unpaid Invoices is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Find the groups of {Vendor-A} and {Vendor-B} and note their order.
  2. Expand {Vendor-B}'s group.
  3. Read the order of {Bill-A}, {Bill-B} and {Bill-C}.
  4. Look at the header of the "Date" column.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: {Vendor-B}'s group is above {Vendor-A}'s group.
  • Step 2: the group opens.
  • Step 3: {Bill-A} first (oldest date), then {Bill-B}, then {Bill-C} (same date, smaller number first, counted as a number).
  • Step 4: "Date" is marked as the sorted column.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11531 (Story 1, Reports open in QuickBooks name order), story SV-11532 (Story 2, Sort by clicking any column header)

  • S1-R6: “A/R Collection groups by customer and A/P Unpaid Invoices by vendor, groups in name order (S1-R2 to S1-R4); inside each group, rows open oldest date first, ties by document number (S2-R4).”
  • S1-R7: “The column the report opened on is marked as sorted: the name column on the Summaries and Detail reports, the Date column on Collection and Unpaid Invoices.”
  • S2-R4: “ID and No. sort by number value: S1-99 before S1-100 before S1-101. The same number-aware order breaks ties in every sort.”
